description: The header JSON at the start of a PSLM v4 cartridge's LSB bitstream (after magic PSLM, version byte 4, and a 4-byte big-endian header length). The extractor needs only version, lsb_depth and parts; every other field is metadata it ignores. Roles (which part is the text, the audio, a model) are just names the renderer uses afterwards — extraction and verification stay role-blind.

audio_format.description: The audio container format (opus-webm), or null when there is no audio part.

fallback.description: The language to use when the reader's language has no gloss.

languages.description: The gloss languages packed, in order.

lsb_depth.description: How many least-significant bits per colour channel the bitstream uses. The decoder tries 1, then 2.

parts.description: A generic, self-describing list of everything that follows the header in the bitstream, in order. The extractor reads whatever the header lists, in order, and verifies each hash; it knows nothing about what any part is.

encoding.description: zlib: the stored bytes are a zlib-compressed copy (decompress after verifying). raw: the stored bytes are the part itself.

len.description: How many bytes the part occupies in the bitstream (0 for a remote part).

name.description: An opaque label. The renderer looks parts up by name: text is the text pack, audio is the audio, world is the scene recipe, every other part is a 3D model.

remote.description: True only when the part is not in the bitstream at all: the decoder fetches it from url and verifies len + sha256 exactly as for an embedded part.

sha256.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the STORED bytes, exactly as they sit in the bitstream. For a remote part, of the original file.

url.description: Present only when remote is true: where to fetch the part from.

strip_h.description: Always 0 in version 4: there is no visible strip. Kept so the header shape is stable across versions.

version.description: Format version. Must match the version byte in the bitstream.

title: PSLM v4 cartridge header
